claims.claim: OpenAI released new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model and published them in a GitHub repository with Lean formalizations.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI released a big collection of new mathematical results created by one of its most advanced internal models. These results tackle open problems in math that researchers have been working on for years. Instead of keeping everything secret, the company put the findings in a public GitHub repository along with computer-checked versions of the proofs written in a language called Lean.
claims.supporting_quote: We’re releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model.

claims.claim: A game developer used ChatGPT to generate over 1200 pieces of artwork including ship rooms, icons, enemies, and backgrounds for an airship strategy game.
claims.episode_span: A longtime artist and game developer used ChatGPT to create more than 1,200 pieces of artwork for a strategy game about airships. The AI handled rooms, icons, enemies, backgrounds, and achievements — work that would have taken the artist years to finish alone.
claims.source_title: GPT made over 1200 images for my Airship Captain game!
claims.supporting_quote: In all it ended up making over 1200 different high quality artwork for ship rooms, icons, achievements, backgrounds, ship types, enemies, and so on and so on.

claims.claim: Anthropic is expanding a program that gives verified security professionals access to its strongest models for defensive work.
claims.episode_span: Anthropic is expanding a program that gives verified security professionals access to its strongest models for defensive work like finding weaknesses in systems before bad actors do.
claims.supporting_quote: We’re expanding our Cyber Verification Program to give security professionals broader access to our most capable models
